gatewayMeasurementRunbook.executor: CampaignOps only; existing demo prepare/start/run/finish and frozen release
gatewayMeasurementRunbook.placement: Freeze six existing manual serving instances (two per workload), or maximum eligible placement on the current eight Nodes; one instance per Node. Record exact Node/Pod UID/profile/mode/allocation/batch/route. No synthetic placement and no scheduler mutation by this config.
gatewayMeasurementRunbook.capacity: Fill capacityR with final approved R after candidate-SLO/jetsonx replay; K is a diagnostic partial sum only, never silently substitute it.
gatewayMeasurementRunbook.sampling: Retain existing 1s cgroup raw; derive nonoverlapping 10s ChillServer CPU delta/elapsed cores and memoryBytes samples, with Pod UID/containerID and gaps. No extra cluster collector required.
gatewayMeasurementRunbook.criteria: One 120s alpha=1.2 shared-CPU gateway check only; no staircase, retry or maximum-G search. Record g0-verdict.v2 with the new demo-e5-binding.v2. Judge full frozen planned=offered=issued supply, generator VALID, receive-origin PLC p95 and deadline success over all offered, gateway rejection/503/timeout/incomplete zero, CS throttle/restart/OOM zero, complete identified CPU/memory 10s samples and memory below its frozen limit. CPU best-effort sharing has no CPU limit denominator: report absolute CPU cores peak only, never judge its size or substitute physical cores. Historical aggregate/Smol SLO/success verdicts remain references, not a gate. Preserve prior raw/judgments; g0Bootstrap permits a new measurement without prior G0, not reuse of controlled-CPU evidence.
